metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.

metas.name: Runner
metas.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

metas.name: The Housemaid
metas.description: Millie a struggling young woman becomes live-in maid for a wealthy couple Nina and Andrew. She enters a mansion of secrets, manipulation, and escalating psychological games that pull her into a dangerous relationship dynamic.

metas.name: Friday the 13th
metas.description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulated that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

metas.name: Hokum
metas.description: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

metas.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: Weapons
metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: In the Grey
metas.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to steal it back--an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and surv...

metas.name: Pressure
metas.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: Two magicians dismantle their lives to outmaneuver each other following a shared tragedy. They chase the ultimate illusion across Victorian London, sacrificing sanity and safety to master a teleportation feat that defies all logic.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: The Sixth Sense
metas.description: After being shot by a resentful former patient whom he failed to help, a Philadelphia child psychologist seeks redemption by treating a young boy with a disturbing secret.

metas.name: The Departed
metas.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Halloween
metas.description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois, to kill again.

metas.name: The Dark Knight
metas.description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

metas.name: Inception
metas.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

metas.name: Sleepy Hollow
metas.description: Ichabod Crane is sent to Sleepy Hollow to investigate the decapitations of three people; the culprit is legendary apparition The Headless Horseman.

metas.name: Seven
metas.description: Two detectives try to track down a serial killer who chooses his victims based on the Seven Deadly Sins.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown's fabled Swedish mid-summer festival. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent and bizarre competition at the hands of a pagan cult.

metas.name: Eyes Wide Shut
metas.description: A Manhattan doctor embarks on a bizarre, night-long odyssey after his wife's admission of unfulfilled longing.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: Heretic
metas.description: Two young Mormon women are drawn into a game of cat-and-mouse in the house of a strange man.

metas.name: The Conjuring
metas.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse.

metas.name: Barbarian
metas.description: A woman staying at an Airbnb discovers that the house she has rented is not what it seems.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

metas.name: Fight Club
metas.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

metas.name: The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: Hellraiser
metas.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands after police fail to find two kidnapped girls.

metas.name: Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: Insidious
metas.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.

metas.name: Normal
metas.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

metas.name: Fall
metas.description: When a high-rise climb goes wrong, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves stuck at the top of a 2,000-foot TV tower.

metas.name: Friday the 13th: Part 2
metas.description: Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: A family is invited to spend a whole weekend in a lonely home in the countryside, but as the weekend progresses, they realize that a dark side lies within the family who invited them.

metas.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith MacCaullay while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: The Town
metas.description: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

metas.name: Gone Girl
metas.description: The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

metas.name: The Long Walk
metas.description: A group of teenage boys compete in an annual contest known as "The Long Walk," in which they must maintain a certain walking speed or get shot.

metas.name: Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
metas.description: Pennsylvania, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.

metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: After being kidnapped and imprisoned for fifteen years, Oh Dae-Su is released, only to find that he must track down his captor in five days.

metas.name: Smile
metas.description: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, a psychiatrist becomes increasingly convinced she is being threatened by an uncanny entity.

metas.name: The Cabin in the Woods
metas.description: Five teens visit a remote cabin and explore its cellar, finding strange items. When Dana reads from a book there, she unleashes zombie killers. But the situation is more complex than it appears.

metas.name: The Others
metas.description: In 1945, immediately following the end of Second World War, a woman who lives with her two photosensitive children on her darkened old family estate in the Channel Islands becomes convinced that the home is haunted.

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Final Destination
metas.description: After getting a premonition about a plane crash on his school trip, Alex, a student, saves a few of his classmates. However, their situation gets complicated when death starts chasing them.

metas.name: Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends head to a remote cabin, where the discovery of a Book of the Dead leads them to unwittingly summon up demons living in the nearby woods.

metas.name: The Rivals of Amziah King
metas.description: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: Psycho
metas.description: A secretary on the run for embezzlement takes refuge at a secluded California motel owned by a repressed man and his overbearing mother.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

metas.name: Apocalypse Now
metas.description: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

metas.name: Shelter
metas.description: A reclusive former government assassin finds his forced isolation shattered when a stranded supply girl triggers a lethal tracking system, forcing him to defend her against his old handler's relentless execution squads.

metas.name: Split
metas.description: Three girls are kidnapped by a man with a diagnosed 23 distinct personalities. They must try to escape before the apparent emergence of a frightful new 24th.

metas.name: The Ring
metas.description: A journalist must investigate a mysterious videotape which seems to cause the death of anyone one week to the day after they view it.

metas.name: The Amateur
metas.description: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a decoder takes matters into his own hands.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: The Beekeeper
metas.description: A former operative of a powerful organization embarks on a brutal campaign for vengeance.

metas.name: The Faculty
metas.description: Six misfit students must band together to save mankind when mind-controlling parasites from another planet infect their high school's faculty.

metas.name: Pearl
metas.description: In 1918, a young woman on the brink of madness pursues stardom in a desperate attempt to escape the drudgery, isolation, and lovelessness of life on her parents' farm.

metas.name: Oculus
metas.description: A recently released inmate from a mental asylum learns from his sister that the murder he was convicted of committing were actually orchestrated by a supernatural entity, the Lasser Glass mirror.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: Rear Window
metas.description: A bored photographer recovering from a broken leg passes the time by watching his neighbors and begins to suspect one of them of murder.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: The Voyeurs
metas.description: Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, but notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite. This will set in motion a chain of events that will lead to disaster.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial vi...

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: Hush
metas.description: A deaf mute European-American writer in her 20's who retreated to the woods to live in solitude must fight for her life in silence when a masked serial killer appears at her window.

metas.name: Lights Out
metas.description: A supernatural entity reemerges to terrorize a family when the lights go out at night.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.
